name: Spring dash stack, upward: an up-right dash carries the first spring's momentum into a second up spring
techNote: The upward case of spring-dash-stack. A floor (top y 0, x -400-200), an up spring on it (the Course 5 ceiling spring's SpringScript: upForce 70, strength 300, movementLock 0.25; trigger 80x80 at x 60-140, y 0-80, unturned: transform.up (0, 1)) and a second one up and to the right (trigger x 190-270, y 190-270). An up spring hit has no cutscene: momentum.y 925, Velocity.y 1530 (2474-2477). A dash up-right the tick after moves momentum into preDashMomentum (1643-1644) and carries the dot 23.6 u a tick each way into the second spring, whose hit calls endDash (hitSpring 2436-2439): 95% of preDashMomentum.y back (sign matches the dash's y, 2035-2037), plus its own 925: momentum.y 1803.8, Velocity.y 1530. It peaks at y 2277 and reaches the finish box (x 350-950, y 2000-2200). The plain launch goes straight up past the second spring and peaks at y 1511.
